final: WITH excl AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL), r1 AS (SELECT L.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(CAST(L.ALP AS REAL) / NULLIF(L.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM excl) GROUP BY L.ID, P.SEX) SELECT sex, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt_by_sex, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_by_sex FROM r1 GROUP BY sex
